body.subject: Coffee making
body.audience: Curious adult beginners who make coffee at home and want more consistent results.
body.prior_knowledge: No formal coffee knowledge; learners can follow simple kitchen measurements.
body.purpose: Help learners understand brewing variables and use a repeatable tasting loop to improve common home coffee.
constraints: Use common home equipment rather than commercial cafe gear.
body.assessment_expectations: Short practical checks and scenario questions.
body.tools_or_equipment: Kettle, brewer, grinder, scale where available.

assumptions.rationale: The user did not specify duration; a short course is enough for a prototype acceptance run.
